prediction_text: Positive — the marriage match can be revived and shall be effected, if the gentleman makes the first move as advised. Jupiter in his exaltation applying to a sextile of Saturn, lord of the 7th and significator of the gentleman, and transferring Saturn's virtue to the Sun, lord of the Ascendant and significator of the lady, with no prohibition, abscission or frustration before the aspect perfects, is a collection/transfer of light that brings the two significators together despite their present estrangement. Receptions between Venus and the Moon and between the Sun and Venus soften the lady's former slighting and the gentleman's resentment; Saturn with Mars in a fixed earthy sign in the south angle, elevated, shows his pride/obstinacy and delay, and the Moon separated from his significator void of course applying to opposition of the Sun shows hesitation and a risk of a quarrelsome interval, but these do not frustrate the Jupiter perfection. Timing is day-scale in June: the gentleman should make the first move on 19 June near noon, main coordinate the perfection of Saturn and Mars / the Jupiter-Saturn aspect on 27 June, by which the revival is sealed.
basis: Lilly 7th-house marriage horary: Sun lord Asc = lady, Saturn lord 7th = gentleman. Decisive testimony is Jupiter exalted, sextile Saturn, transferring light to the Sun without prohibition before perfection (27 June) — classical collection of light for a matter otherwise unperfected. Moon void/separated and applying to Sun opposition, and Saturn-Mars conjunction in fixed earth, are recorded as delay/pride testimonies subordinate to the unfrustrated perfection. Input year not stated, prose positions only.
